prompt: How will the leader help players who cannot stay past six?
promptZh: 帶領人會怎麼協助不能留到六點以後的團員？

options.text: Let them ring one bell quietly upstairs.
options.zh: 讓他們在樓上小聲敲一支鈴。
options.whyZh: 室內禁敲鈴，沒有單支的例外。

options.text: Practice the switch from two bells to one first, using hand movements upstairs.
options.zh: 先在樓上用手部動作練習從兩支鈴換成一支。
options.whyZh: 提早走的團員需要這段轉換，因此先練；室內只練動作。

options.text: Ask them to practice only after the study group leaves.
options.zh: 請他們等讀書小組離開才練。
options.whyZh: 安排的是先練手部動作，不必等讀書小組離開。

options.text: Ask them to bring one extra bell to the room.
options.zh: 請他們多帶一支鈴到室內。
options.whyZh: 要練的是從兩支換成一支，不是添一支鈴。

explanationZh: 提早走的團員需要這段轉換，因此先練；室內只練動作。
evidence: No ringing indoors today. We can practice the hand movements without bells. The courtyard is free after six if we want to hear the actual notes. / Some players have to leave by six.
